headline: IRGC claims it downed a US MQ-9 drone over the Strait of Hormuz early Tuesday, calling it the 54th
dek: IRGC says its air defences intercepted and destroyed a US MQ-9 drone over the Strait of Hormuz early Tuesday using a 'new advanced air defence system' under Iran's integrated air-defence network; claims it is the 54th US MQ-9 it has downed since the US-Israeli war began Feb 28. No precise…
sources: IRGC Aerospace Force statement via Iranian state-aligned agencies (Fars, Tasnim, Mehr, IRIB)
fault_line: Tehran publishes a running tally of American drones it says it killed — and Washington never confirms or denies. Is the Pentagon hiding the real attrition, or is Iran inflating the scoreboard?

sections.what_happened: IRGC says its air defences intercepted and destroyed a US MQ-9 drone over the Strait of Hormuz early Tuesday using a 'new advanced air defence system' under Iran's integrated air-defence network; claims it is the 54th US MQ-9 it has downed since the US-Israeli war began Feb 28. No precise location/mission established; CENTCOM/US has not commented (Pajhwok: 'CENTCOM has not yet commented'; Khaama notes US also silent on Sept Qeshm claim; Life News: Washington 'generally not confirmed or denied' Iranian downing claims).
sections.what_verified: Dawn, Aaj English TV, Pajhwok, Khaama, Yeni Safak, ANews, Tribune.com.pk, Arab Times, Life News Agency, Shafaq, Sunday Guardian, Mehr, Tasnim, Fars. Context corroboration: Washington Post (Aug 13, 3 US officials): US military lost at least 45 MQ-9 Reapers during the war (~1/4 of pre-war fleet, ~$1.3B). Prior Iranian claims: Aug 31 (Hormuz), Sept (Qeshm Island, '52nd'), May, July.
sections.what_disputed: No US confirmation or denial; TOI description embeds unverified sub-claim ('US struck a naval base on Iran's southeastern coast, wounding two Iranian troops' a day earlier) — not confirmed elsewhere. '54th' tally is Iran's own count, not independently audited.
sections.why_matters: While Trump threatens to 'finish the job' with bigger bombs, Tehran says its air defences just bagged the 54th US Reaper over Hormuz — and the Pentagon won't confirm or deny. Map the attrition: WaPo's own reporting says America has lost ~45 Reapers, a quarter of its fleet. Iran-side framing: the air war Washington is fighting is costing it drones it never admits to losing.
